generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: independent generated website logo for car dealership, transparent PNG.
Primary request: premium but unpretentious original identity with EXACT text "Chiron Used Cars Trading", no other copy.
Concept: a striking bespoke open "C" monogram built from two offset precision-cut arcs, conveying confident motion through negative space without copying any existing luxury car logo.
Style: high-end flat vector logo design; clear, geometrically articulate typography; powerful silhouette; not futuristic chrome or supercar-cliché.
Palette: charcoal blue-black with a restrained metallic-looking flat silver-grey accent (solid fills only).
Composition: icon left, elegant "CHIRON" prominent and "USED CARS TRADING" smaller but crisp; generous true transparent alpha padding, works in header, separable compact emblem.
Constraints: exact spelling "Chiron Used Cars Trading", no Bugatti reference, no known vehicle manufacturer emblems, no shields, horse, wings, generic vehicle illustrations, 3D, gradients, watermark or background box. This is an independent proposal, not official branding.

holdReasons: Genuine source branding not visually compared against concept
Separate compact mark and on-dark/accent variants incomplete
No maintained pack or six-design visual release checks
